payload.summary: Created from the 2026-07-25 distill cwd quirk: nahel distill run from nahel/journal/archive/ failed with 'nahel/config not found at <cwd>/nahel/config' — cli.ts injects process.cwd() straight into storeLayout, no parent walk. Committee consult (codex + cursor-agent), both SHIP-IT with converging design: existing-store commands walk up to the nearest nahel/config like git finds .git, bounded by the current git worktree boundary (worktrees stay isolated); init stays cwd-strict so it cannot silently nest a second store. Walk-up is deterministic (same cwd -> same root).
